subject: health
concept: Understanding how to balance competing life demands (school, work, relationships, rest) without sacrificing wellbeing
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Discipline and Boundaries Pillars — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student maps out a realistic weekly schedule balancing multiple life demands
exercise.abstract: Student explains a specific tradeoff they made in their schedule and why they made it

assessment.mastery_threshold: schedule reflects a genuine, realistic balance across multiple life areas
misconception_flags: schedule neglects rest or wellbeing entirely in favor of only productivity-focused demands

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
